question: Does Avrea offer an identity_cost.kind other than email for GitHub-OAuth-only registration, given the closed set has no OAuth term?
why: The console sign-in at https://console.avrea.com/ is 'Continue with GitHub' or company SSO and needs no affiliation; GitHub personal accounts need a verified email. The corpus has no term for an OAuth-only gate, so email is the nearest closed-set term used for comparable GitHub sign-in records such as compute/github-codespaces and compute/e2b.
